questions.stem: In a detailed session on the evaluation of screening tests in a clinical setting, the focus is placed on understanding the validity of these tests. Validity involves the accuracy with which a test measures what it is intended to. Among the following statements, which accurately describes a relationship true with respect to the validity of a screening test?
questions.stemHtml: In a detailed session on the evaluation of screening tests in a clinical setting, the focus is placed on understanding the validity of these tests. Validity involves the accuracy with which a test measures what it is intended to. Among the following statements, which accurately describes a relationship true with respect to the validity of a screening test?

options.label: B
options.text: Positive predictive value = 1 – Negative predictive value

options.label: C
options.text: Sensitivity is inversely proportional to specificity
